mapper.select: SELECT T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /* 서비스실행사업번호 */ , T2.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM /* 서비스실행사업명 */ FROM SEB120 T1 /* 서비스사업대상자 */ , SDA420 T2 /* 서비스실행사업 */ WHERE T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND T1.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T2.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO ORDER BY T2.LAST_MDFCN_DT DESC

SELECT T1.SRVC_PVSN_PLAN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_PLAN_NO /* 서비스제공계획번호 */ , T1.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /* 자원번호 */ , T1.PLAN_FNDNG_YMD AS PLAN_FNDNG_YMD /* 계획수립일자 */ , T1.SRVC_GOAL_CN AS SRVC_GOAL_CN /* 서비스목표내용 */ , T1.SRVC_GOAL_TTL_NM AS SRVC_GOAL_TTL_NM /* 서비스목표제목명 */ , T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /* 서비스실행사업번호 */ , T1.PVSN_RESRCE_PRIR_RANK AS PVSN_RESRCE_PRIR_RANK /* 제공자원우선순위 */ , T1.INTRVN_ERA_SE_CD AS INTRVN_ERA_SE_CD /* 개입시기구분코드 */ , T1.PVSN_PRNMNT_BGNG_YMD AS PVSN_PRNMNT_BGNG_YMD /* 제공예정시작일자 */ , T1.PVSN_PRNMNT_END_YMD AS PVSN_PRNMNT_END_YMD /* 제공예정종료일자 */ , T1.PVSN_PRNMNT_BGNG_HR AS PVSN_PRNMNT_BGNG_HR /* 제공예정시작시간 */ , T1.PVSN_PRNMNT_END_HR AS PVSN_PRNMNT_END_HR /* 제공예정종료시간 */ , T1.PIC_NO AS PIC_NO /* 담당자번호 */ , T1.TKCG_INST_NO AS TKCG_INST_NO /* 담당기관번호 */ , T1.SRVC_GR_PVSN_YN AS SRVC_GR_PVSN_YN /* 서비스집단제공여부 */ , T1.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN /* 삭제여부 */ FROM SEB300 T1 /* 서비스제공계획 */ WHERE T1.SRVC_PVSN_PLAN_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_PLAN_NO} /* 서비스제공계획번호 */ AND T1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} /* 자원번호 */ AND T1.DEL_YN != 'Y' /* 삭제여부 */

SELECT T1.SRVC_PVSN_PLAN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_PLAN_NO /* 서비스제공계획번호 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , T1.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /* 자원번호 */ , T1.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN /* 삭제여부 */ FROM SEB310 T1 /* 서비스제공계획대상자 */ WHERE T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} /* 사례관리번호 */ AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} /* 사례관리차수 */ AND T1.DEL_YN != 'Y' /* 삭제여부 */
AND T1.SRVC_PVSN_PLAN_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_PLAN_NO} /* 서비스제공계획번호 */
AND T1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} /* 자원번호 */
